title: Abakhi Bezinsika Eziphakeme
intro: Umi phambi kwamanxiwa omuzi wasendulo omuhle kakhulu, izinsika zawo eziphakeme seziwile. Umoya uvunguza emigwaqweni engenalutho, uphethe inkumbulo yabantu abanamandla abake babusa la mazwe. Babengobani?
clues: Sasingabantu abanamandla amakhulu namakhono, saziwa ngezakhiwo zethu ezinkulu kanye nempucuko ethuthukile.
Sasihlala ezweni elinezindunduma zesihlabathi namagquma anamatshe, futhi sasikholelwa ukuthi akekho ongasinqoba.
Isithunywa safika kithi sivela phakathi kwezihlobo zethu, sisibiza ukuba sikhonze u-Allah yedwa, kodwa samlahla futhi samhleka usulu.
Sazigqaja sathi, ‘Ngubani onamandla kunathi?’ saqhubeka nokuzikhukhumeza kwethu nokukhulekela izithombe.
U-Allah wathumela phezu kwethu umoya onamandla owavunguza ubusuku obuyisikhombisa nezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili, wachitha yonke into.
Sasingabantu baka-'Ad, abakhi be-Iram, futhi isiphetho sethu saba yisixwayiso kubo bonke abalandela.

outcome.label: Sasiyini isiphetho sabo sokugcina?
options: Babhujiswa futhi izinsalela zabo zaba yisifundo
outcome.answer: Babhujiswa futhi izinsalela zabo zaba yisifundo

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
